title: The explicit diagonal comparison unit
statement: Let X be a scheme and A a functor from etale set sheaves on X to pro-etale set sheaves on X. Suppose e_F,Y identifies A(F)(Y) with terminal sections of the etale inverse image Y.hom^*F, naturally in coefficient maps, and intertwines restriction along each Z to Y with the inverse-image unit along that arrow followed by inverse terminal transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport]. define eta from the identity functor on etale set sheaves to A followed by restriction. Its component on F at an etale U sends s to e_F,U inverse of the inverse-image unit restricted along the diagonal. Its data is this explicit formula. Naturality in site arrows uses [lem-cbc-comparison-diagonal-section-naturality] and hres; naturality in F uses hfun and the inverse-image unit and sheaf-morphism naturality equations. No adjunction or arbitrary witness is chosen.

source.place: Tag 0GLZ, diagonal unit and sectionwise transpose argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GLZ (read online; local source absent)

proof.text: Construct the section maps by the stated diagonal formula and e inverse. The site naturality law is diagonal naturality followed by hres. Coefficient naturality follows from hfun, naturality of the inverse-image unit in F, and naturality of the pulled-back coefficient morphism at the diagonal.

def proEtaleComparisonSectionUnit (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)) ⥤
      Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1)))
    (e : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (Y : X.ProEt),
      (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y) ≃
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F).obj.obj
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))))
    (hres : ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
      (Y Z : X.ProEt) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (s : (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y)),
      e F Z ((A.obj F).obj.map g.op s) =
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g.left) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Z.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
                (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) ≫
            (etaleSetTerminalTransport Y.hom g.left Z.hom g.w F).inv) (e F Y s))
    (hfun : ∀ (F F' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (ψ : F ⟶ F')
      (Y : X.ProEt) (s : (A.obj F).obj.obj (op Y)),
      e F' Y ((A.map ψ).hom.app (op Y) s) =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).map ψ).hom.app
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) (e F Y s)) :
    𝟭 (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) ⟶
      A ⋙ (Scheme.toProEt X).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type (u + 1)) X.smallEtaleTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
